findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed that the interior of the lid on the ice machine has some bare insulation. Insulation is an absorbent material that is not smooth and easily cleanable. PIC was notified and will have the lid repaired so that the insulation is no longer uncovered. Ensure that food-contact surfaces of equipment are nonabsorbent and are smooth and easily cleanable.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. [C]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed milk and half & half opened over 24 hours ago without proper date marking. There was also half & half that had expired on 09/03/2024. The half & half was discarded. The inspector educated the PIC about proper date marking. Ensure that foods kept at the facility for longer than 24 hours are date marked to indicate the 7 day maximum.

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf).
